name: open-musicflow
description: Open-source cleanroom implementation of LG Music Flow PC Software for Linux, Windows, and macOS
author: Open MusicFlow Contributors <maintainers@open-musicflow.local>

scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && esbuild src/backend/standaloneServer.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --outfile=dist-electron/backend/standaloneServer.js && esbuild src/electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --external:electron --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --outfile=dist-electron/electron/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
